data.body: RCA for terraform-config-inspect canary failure on CL 2666 PS8: classification (a), functional regression in the reviewed patchset relative to current required CI base, but not caused by scanner logic. PS8 was based on 0033662b5534 and lacked merged fix f95d-19f6-7e58-4a8e / commit 50716c9aed87. Evidence: CI run 33972930927 job 101324852887 failed tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py::test_pinned_upstream_canary at line 429 with AssertionError assert 'abstain' == 'match'. Commit 50716c9 documents and fixes the exact mechanism: old _run passed the absolute snapshot path to terraform-config-inspect; upstream echoed that argument in pos.filename, and _validate_positions rejected the absolute filename as path_outside_snapshot. I reproduced the decisive mechanism locally with a fake real-shape terraform-config-inspect: seeding the old absolute-argv behavior returned outcome=abstain reason_detail=path_outside_snapshot; after rebasing onto origin/main (which includes 50716c9 and later canary fixes), the same canary path with a fake real-shape binary passed. Fix applied here: rebase CL 2666 onto current origin/main (9e6a0e436520), inheriting 50716c9/10533b1/d49fea4 without changing scanner semantics. Validation after rebase: grounding suite plus scanner/parity targets 511 passed/1 skipped; make lint and make typecheck passed; plan review recertified PASS for head e3712b7c9275. No submit/close performed.
